rule.name: JpaMultipleCollectionFetch
rule.message: Load at most one collection per query with join fetch or an entity graph, and the others in their own query or with @BatchSize or @Fetch(FetchMode.SUBSELECT): two fetched collections return one row for every pair of their elements, and Hibernate throws MultipleBagFetchException for two lists.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.NamedQuery') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.NamedQuery'))] [count(tokenize(lower-case(string-join(.//StringLiteral/@ConstValue, ' ')), 'join\s+fetch\s')) > 2] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('createQuery', 'createSelectionQuery')] [let $first := ArgumentList/*[1], $constant := ancestor::ClassBody[last()]/FieldDeclaration /VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $first[self::VariableAccess]/@Name] return count(tokenize(lower-case(string-join( ($first/descendant-or-self::StringLiteral, $constant//StringLiteral)/@ConstValue, ' ')), 'join\s+fetch\s')) > 2] | //Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.EntityGraph')] [count(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'attributePaths']//StringLiteral) > 1] | //Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.NamedEntityGraph') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.NamedEntityGraph')] [count(.//Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.NamedAttributeNode') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.NamedAttributeNode')]) > 1] | (//MethodDeclaration | //LambdaExpression[not(ancestor::MethodDeclaration)]) /(descendant::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'fetch'] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.criteria.FetchParent') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.criteria.FetchParent')]])[2]
